dataset.source: C4 (allenai/c4) English, VALIDATION split, shard en/c4-validation.00000-of-00008.json.gz
dataset.split_provenance: official C4 validation split file (distinct file family from c4-train.*); historical calibration used ONLY c4-train.00000-of-01024 (data_utils.get_splits, build_confirmation_split) at the same repo revision

selection.rule: random.Random(seed): shuffle validation-shard row indices; for each document in that order tokenize the full text (no special tokens added); skip if <= 512 tokens; draw start = rng.randint(0, n - 513) (data_utils.get_splits convention); window = ids[start:start+512]; content-only exclusion rules (below) applied BEFORE any model evaluation; stop at 128; order windows by ascending shard row

exclusion_rules.text_in_c4_train: document text sha256 equals a C4 train-shard-00000 document
exclusion_rules.url_in_c4_train: document URL appears in C4 train shard 00000
exclusion_rules.exact_window_in_history: 512-token window equals any historical token row
exclusion_rules.ngram_overlap_history: window shares any 13-token n-gram with any historical calibration/tuning/evaluation token row
exclusion_rules.ngram_overlap_selected: window shares any 13-gram with an already selected window (near-duplicate guard)

sequence_construction.scoring: identical to historical: logits[:, :-1] vs input_ids[:, 1:]; FP32 CE, FP64 accumulation; PPL = exp(total NLL / 65408); batch 8; fixed window order
